cues.text: Mylgor has already been expecting you.
He greets you briefly and comes straight to business:
"I hope you still remember the pact we made last night.
Well, now it is time for you to fulfil your part of our agreement:
there is an evil elf king named Firon,
who hides with his horde in his ice palace in the northwest of our beloved country.
Yet he often raids our small, peaceful village with his yeti army and plunders it -
a few years ago he even burned it to the ground!
As head of the village council, I command you: stop him!
Here are some clothes you will need to survive in the cold ice regions,
and a flask with a magic elixir that makes you invisible for a few seconds:
do not use it unless it is absolutely unavoidable, because, as I said,
it will protect you for one move only, and you can use it only once!
Now be on your way and put an end to Firon's dark schemes: may Zargon protect you...!"
With these words, Mylgor opens a small chest,
takes out the things he mentioned and spreads them out on the table in front of you.
